title: 錯
teacherNotes: Production D asset-complete-package for L223. Latest origin/main is complete through L215 and R012, so L216-L222 are provisional dependencies. Production owns request, packet, draft JSON, final images, final sentence audio, charAudio, Stage 4 G02/G05 audio, alignment, and registry status. Release owns production JSON insertion, planner export, ledger update, final verify, merge, and deployment.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main production JSON through L215 plus provisional learned chars 身, 濕, 乾, 服, 褲, 換, 改 plus current target 錯
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 for protagonist mother, father, and protagonist little girl.
Teacher must be visually distinct from protagonist mother if used.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, names, school names, badges, battery plus/minus symbols, brands, or readable marks.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 錯 as public/assets/lessons/L223/audio/char-u932f.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 男孩同學做錯事後，主角老師或主角媽媽溫和地引導他改過；畫面可以是男孩同學把弄亂的桌子重新整理好，表現做錯後願意改過。若使用老師，老師必須和主角媽媽視覺上不同。不可有文字、數字或標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 褲子拿錯了，改天拿去還。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 褲子拿錯了改天拿去還
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩把別人的褲子拿回家了，在家中發現褲子拿錯，主角媽媽提醒她改天拿去學校還給同學。畫面要清楚呈現「拿錯褲子、之後要拿去還」的情境，可用主角小女孩拿著不屬於自己的褲子、旁邊有書包或校服提示學校來源；不可有姓名、文字、數字或標籤。
學校體育課結束後，兩位女同學角色：主角小女孩和女同學，在準備換回校服時發現彼此穿錯校服，需要快換回來。畫面必須是在學校或教室附近的安全換裝前後情境，只呈現發現穿錯與準備更正，不呈現更衣過程；兩位學生都必須是女同學，不要畫成男女同學互換。校服上不可有校名、文字、數字、徽章字樣或標籤。
主角爸爸和主角小女孩在家中看著一個小玩具的電池盒，乾電池放錯方向，所以玩具沒有動。畫面要清楚表現乾電池放錯邊，但電池盒、玩具、電池上不可有文字、正負號、數字、品牌或標籤。
主角小女孩的褲子被水弄濕，主角媽媽提醒她先換乾的褲子；旁邊可有乾的褲子放在椅子上。畫面只呈現提醒和準備換的安全情境，不呈現更衣過程；不可有文字、數字或標籤。

G01.reason: 「放錯邊」是本課清楚用法，目標字明確。
